sweeps.name: topology-ep
sweeps.narrative: Expert parallelism should win at every width, and wider tp should beat wider dp on 10k-token prompts.

sweeps.name: batch-prefill
sweeps.narrative: The per-step token cap should set ITL, and chunking long prefills should trade throughput for ITL below it.

sweeps.name: kv-capacity
sweeps.narrative: fp8 KV should pay most where many resident 10k-token sequences make KV the binding resource.
